title: 分析对比：对不齐的上期时间桶保留原键，会覆盖本期首桶的对比值
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

## 维护者速读
报表或仪表盘按「和上一期对比」画按周/按月的图时，如果上一期的时间段切出来的格子数和本期不一样，多出来的那一格没有对应位置，却保留了自己的日期键；它可能正好和本期第一格同名，于是悄悄覆盖掉本期第一格本该有的对比值，图上显示的对比数字是错的，而且不报错。
要你做的：无（等分诊定级）。

## Defect

`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`, in the compare pass (the `sub.rows.map` that renames measures to `<measure>__compare`):

```ts
const aligned = alignedCompareBucketKey(row[dimension], granularity, cmp.kind, range, shifted);
if (aligned != null) out[dimension] = aligned;
```

When `alignedCompareBucketKey` returns `null` (the shifted bucket's target ordinal falls outside the current window), the row keeps its OWN bucket key. If that key equals a bucket of the current window, `mergeByDimensions` writes the compare column onto that row, overwriting the value the aligned row put there, or appending an extra row outside the window.

**Example (by reading, found by the contract review of PR #36767).** "This month" in December 2026 on a week axis. `previousPeriod` is the 31 days ending Nov 30, and its weeks do not map one-to-one onto December's. A shifted bucket whose target falls outside December keeps a key that can collide with `2026-W49`, so that week's comparison becomes the single day Nov 30 instead of the aligned week. On a month axis, the unaligned bucket appears as an extra bar outside the window (for example, an extra November bar for "this month" by month).

**Reach.** Dashboard widgets with `compareTo` on a time axis can hit it today. The report viewer's comparison switch (#36645, PR #36767) is not offered on the window's own date axis, so it does not reach this.

## Fix shape (proposal)

Drop a compare row whose bucket cannot be aligned (`aligned == null` on a granular time dimension) instead of keeping its own key. Pin it with this month by week and this quarter by month: no compare value lands on a bucket it was not aligned to, and no row is added outside the current window.

## Dedupe

#6007, #27111 and #30197 (closed) covered the alignment rule itself. No open issue covers the unaligned fallback.
